THE_ARCHITECT.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISP: I've heard about you. Wasted potential.
Neow is using you. Though I'm sure you know that.
She's dead. Make peace with that.
Pathetic. Another loop it is, then.
Why not join me? Perhaps I could bring her back.
A shame. I could use someone of your talents.
DARV.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACED.0-0:
We meet again!
Still looking to fix that clock?
DARV.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACED.1-0:
I got all sortsa new timepieces, friend!
Care to take a look?
DARV.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACED.2-0: You sure there's nothing I can trade ya for that clock?
DARV.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACED.2-2: Well, I can't be having that, esteemed customer!
NONUPEIPE.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACE: You interest me, sorry one. Come forth, let me adorn you.
This attire won't do for someone of your... [i]prior[/i] status.
We meet again, sorry one. Still haven't saved your partner?

No blessings yet, sorry one.
Tell me, why do you fight?

Something... no... someone important...
Neow... will bring her back...

How noble indeed!
Come to me, and take a blessing, pitiful one.
OROBAS.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACED.0:
Strange traveller! Quiet!
Who are you?! Strange clock!
OROBAS.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACED.1:
Confused friend! Do you remember??
Take this, it will help!!
OROBAS.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACED.2: Strange creature... we've met before... haven't we...?

Confused friend is remembering!! Take this!
It will help you!!
Thank you... I will... remember this...
PAEL.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACED.0-0:
[thinky_dots]You are so fatigued... you can relax here...
Take a piece of mine... and sleep.[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACED.1-0:
[thinky_dots]Your dreams are so scary...
Take from me and find some peace...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACED.2-0:
[thinky_dots]You're trying too hard...
Why not take a break?[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACED.2-1: No... Something important... I can't stop...
TANX.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACED.1-0: WEAPONS FOR YOU! TAKE A WEAPON AND LEARN!!
TANX.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACED.2-1: [i][font_size=22]The Displaced dodges a mighty blow during the battle.[/font_size][/i]
TEZCATARA.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACE:
You poor thing...
Time is running out... no...?
No one is safe from [jitter][b]burning out[/b][/jitter], dear.
Come in, come in! You look so cold...

Even with that clock...
You're still running out of [jitter][b]time[/b][/jitter].
VAKUU.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACED.0-: So desperate... My favorite type of puppet.
Help me... I can make it worth your while...
VAKUU.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACED.1-: How many times now have you tried and failed?
VAKUU.talk.THEDISPLACED-THE_DISPLACED.2-: Perhaps I can bring her back. What can you offer me?
[red][jitter]He[/jitter][/red] told me not to trust you...
